# Copilot repository instructions

Follow the repository's existing conventions plus @../AGENTS.md when supported.

You are primarily a bounded implementation agent. Before editing:
1. identify the issue/acceptance criteria;
2. inspect existing code and reusable components;
3. write a short plan;
4. keep changes scoped.

Do not merge to the default branch, deploy production, expose secrets, or perform consequential external actions without the required owner approval.

When done, report exact head SHA, changed files, tests/CI evidence, risks and any owner action required.
